svg.aria-label: CruxIQ: Geopolitical risk intelligence for Indian industrial energy buyers. Llama-3.1 extracts structured events from news feeds; deterministic scoring over 11,926 rows of Indian Gas Exchange data across 1,397 trading days. 77.8% hit rate on a five-year backtest. Finalist, ET AI Hackathon 2.0.
